preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of stones N for each player must be between 1 and 100000.
The lengths of strings A and B must both be equal to N.

postconditions.description: The output string S must have a length of 2 * N.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: All characters in the output string S must be lowercase alphabets.
The output string S must be the lexicographically smallest string that can be formed from the concatenation of A and B.
